title: Level 0: Web Orientation & Developer Environment
description: Foundational orientation to frontend development, browser runtimes, client-server mechanics, and DevTools workflows.

title: Level 1: Core Web Standards & Styling Architecture
description: Semantic HTML, document structure, modern CSS layouts (Flexbox, Grid), box model, cascade, and responsive web design.

title: Level 2: JavaScript & TypeScript Language Mastery
description: JavaScript execution engine, DOM manipulation, asynchronous programming, closures, prototypes, and TypeScript type systems.

title: Level 3: Framework & UI Engineering (React)
description: Component architecture, JSX, hooks lifecycle, declarative state modeling, event handling, forms, and composition patterns.

title: Level 4: Quality, State Management & Testing
description: Global state architectures, client-side routing, unit and integration testing with Vitest/Playwright, accessibility, and security.

title: Level 5: Frontend Architecture & High-Scale Systems
description: Next.js / SSR, Core Web Vitals optimization, bundle budgets, micro-frontends, design systems, and staff-level engineering.
